exam_scheme.note: The Cost and Management Accountant (CMA) qualification is governed by the Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICMAI), a statutory professional body under the Cost and Works Accountants Act, 1959. Under CMA Syllabus 2022, the qualification framework comprises three stages: CMA Foundation (4 Papers), CMA Intermediate (2 Groups, 8 Papers), and CMA Final (2 Groups, 8 Papers), integrated with mandatory 15 months of practical training and SAP Finance Power User training. Passing standard: minimum 40% marks in each individual paper and 50% in aggregate of each group/level.

stages.source_label: ICMAI — Scheme of Foundation Examination under Syllabus 2022

papers.paper_name: Paper 1: Fundamentals of Business Laws and Business Communication
papers.negative_marking: Objective Multiple Choice Questions (no negative marking)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40% in paper and 50% in aggregate across all 4 Foundation papers

papers.paper_name: Paper 2: Fundamentals of Financial and Cost Accounting
papers.negative_marking: Objective Multiple Choice Questions (no negative marking)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40% in paper and 50% in aggregate across all 4 Foundation papers

papers.paper_name: Paper 3: Fundamentals of Business Mathematics and Statistics
papers.negative_marking: Objective Multiple Choice Questions (no negative marking)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40% in paper and 50% in aggregate across all 4 Foundation papers

papers.paper_name: Paper 4: Fundamentals of Business Economics and Management
papers.negative_marking: Objective Multiple Choice Questions (no negative marking)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40% in paper and 50% in aggregate across all 4 Foundation papers

stages.stage_name: Stage II: CMA Intermediate Examination (Two Groups, 8 Papers)

papers.paper_name: Group I - Paper 5: Business Laws and Ethics
papers.negative_marking: Section A Objective (no negative marking) + Section B Descriptive problems
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40% in individual paper and 50% aggregate across Group I

papers.paper_name: Group I - Paper 6: Financial Accounting
papers.negative_marking: Objective questions + Descriptive accounting problems
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40% in individual paper and 50% aggregate across Group I

papers.paper_name: Group I - Paper 7: Direct and Indirect Taxation
papers.negative_marking: Section A Direct Tax (50 marks); Section B Indirect Tax - GST & Customs (50 marks)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40% in individual paper and 50% aggregate across Group I

papers.paper_name: Group I - Paper 8: Cost Accounting
papers.negative_marking: Cost accounting principles, standard costing, and cost sheet analysis
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40% in individual paper and 50% aggregate across Group I

papers.paper_name: Group II - Paper 9: Operations Management and Strategic Management
papers.negative_marking: Section A Operations Management (60 marks); Section B Strategic Management (40 marks)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40% in individual paper and 50% aggregate across Group II

papers.paper_name: Group II - Paper 10: Corporate Accounting and Auditing
papers.negative_marking: Section A Corporate Accounting (50 marks); Section B Auditing (50 marks)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40% in individual paper and 50% aggregate across Group II

papers.paper_name: Group II - Paper 11: Financial Management and Business Data Analytics
papers.negative_marking: Section A Financial Management (80 marks); Section B Data Analytics (20 marks)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40% in individual paper and 50% aggregate across Group II

papers.paper_name: Group II - Paper 12: Management Accounting
papers.negative_marking: Activity based costing, marginal costing, decision-making
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40% in individual paper and 50% aggregate across Group II

stages.stage_name: Stage III: CMA Final Examination (Two Groups, 8 Papers)

papers.paper_name: Group III - Paper 13: Corporate and Economic Laws
papers.negative_marking: Corporate governance, securities, IBC and foreign exchange laws
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40% in individual paper and 50% aggregate across Group III

papers.paper_name: Group III - Paper 14: Strategic Financial Management
papers.negative_marking: Capital budgeting, derivatives, valuation and portfolio management
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40% in individual paper and 50% aggregate across Group III

papers.paper_name: Group III - Paper 15: Direct Tax Laws and International Taxation
papers.negative_marking: Direct tax assessment, transfer pricing, and DTAA
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40% in individual paper and 50% aggregate across Group III

papers.paper_name: Group III - Paper 16: Strategic Cost Management
papers.negative_marking: Strategic cost management, pricing policy, supply chain cost management
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40% in individual paper and 50% aggregate across Group III

papers.paper_name: Group IV - Paper 17: Cost and Management Audit
papers.negative_marking: Statutory cost audit, CRA-1/2/3/4 forms, and internal audit
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40% in individual paper and 50% aggregate across Group IV

papers.paper_name: Group IV - Paper 18: Corporate Financial Reporting
papers.negative_marking: Ind AS, consolidated financial statements, business combinations
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40% in individual paper and 50% aggregate across Group IV

papers.paper_name: Group IV - Paper 19: Indirect Tax Laws and Practice
papers.negative_marking: Advanced GST provisions, litigation, appeals, and foreign trade policy
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40% in individual paper and 50% aggregate across Group IV

papers.paper_name: Group IV - Paper 20: Elective (Strategic Performance Management / Risk Management in Banking / Entrepreneurship)
papers.negative_marking: Specialised elective examination
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40% in individual paper and 50% aggregate across Group IV
